$comment: Specs that require a real Supabase — the ones the `e2e-authenticated` CI job runs.
Kept under version control so that losing coverage is a RED build, not a quieter one.
Discovery (scripts/lib/auth-specs.mjs) compares against this list on every run and
fails in both directions: a spec that stops being detected (renamed fixture, new
indirection, deletion) and a spec newly detected but not yet accepted here.
Adding an authenticated spec? Add its path below in the same commit.
$quarantine_comment: Specs that DESCRIBE A DASHBOARD THAT NO LONGER EXISTS. They were merged, the
cockpit was rebuilt (THI-327 Situation Hero, #217 / #236), and nothing objected
because they had never executed anywhere: CI skipped them for want of a Supabase.
Running them for the first time on 2026-07-26 is what surfaced this.
They are listed, printed on every run with their reason, and NOT silently skipped.
Follow-up: rewrite each against the current dashboard, then delete its entry here.
2026-07-29 (ADR-034 / ADR-035, chantier 1). The ROOT CAUSE of the first three
is fixed: CardTitle now renders a real <h3> (src/components/ui/card.tsx), so
getByRole('heading', ...) can match. NONE of the six leaves quarantine in this
commit, on purpose. Releasing a spec that has not been SEEN green sends it
straight into the authenticated job (floor: 31 passed) and turns that job red —
which is the same 'a suite that shrinks in silence' failure, pointing the other
way. Verifying them needs a local Supabase: `supabase start` requires Docker,
which is not installed on the machine this ran on, and the linked project is
PRODUCTION, so pointing the authenticated job at it would write real rows.
Whoever has Docker: run the job, then remove the entries that pass.

quarantine.e2e/accounts.spec.ts: READY TO VERIFY (2026-07-29). Root cause fixed — CardTitle now renders <h3>, so getByRole('heading', /plan du mois/i) can match. Not yet executed against a real Supabase; remove this entry once seen green.
quarantine.e2e/dashboard-expenses.spec.ts: READY TO VERIFY (2026-07-29). Same fix: getByRole('heading', /dépenses —/i) now has a real heading to match. Note the card it targets was relabelled « Dépensé ce mois » by ADR-035, so the regex may need updating alongside verification.
quarantine.e2e/dashboard-data-flow.spec.ts: PARTIALLY FIXED (2026-07-29). The heading-role cause is gone (CardTitle is <h3>), but getByText(/^Factures /i) still targets a surface the cockpit rebuild replaced. Needs a rewrite, not just a re-run.
quarantine.e2e/dashboard-capacite-tryptique.spec.ts: STILL INVALID, and now permanently. Asserts testids substat-reste-disponible / substat-reste-a-vivre / capacite-epargne-card / capacite-epargne-substats. ADR-035 removed the « capacité d'épargne » and « reste à vivre » concepts outright, so these surfaces will never come back. Candidate for deletion rather than rewrite.

$quarantine_is_keyed_by_spec_path: Toute clé de `quarantine` est lue comme un chemin de spec. Ne rien y écrire
d'autre : une note ajoutée dans cet objet le 2026-07-31 a fait compter 16
specs au lieu de 15, sans que la vérification de sélection ne bronche —
elle compare le tableau `specs`, pas les clés de `quarantine`.
2026-07-31 — DÉCOUPAGE AU CAS. dashboard-cockpit-bloc2 et
dashboard-simulator-drawer sont sortis de la quarantaine. Mesuré en parité
CI (CLI Supabase 2.84.2, retries 2, chromium-desktop + iPhone 14) : 7 de
leurs 12 cas passent — 2/6 pour bloc2, 5/6 pour simulator-drawer. Une
quarantaine au FICHIER retenait les 12. Les 5 cas réellement cassés portent
désormais un `test.skip(true, raison)` à leur propre niveau, imprimé par le
reporter. Plancher authentifié : 31 → 38. Un plancher qui monte parce qu'on
a cessé de retenir du vert est le mouvement sain.
Les 4 entrées restantes ont été VUES ROUGES le 2026-07-31, pas supposées :
accounts:75 (montant 500,00 absent), dashboard-expenses:64 (5,00 € absent),
dashboard-data-flow:33 (getByLabel du formulaire charge ne matche plus),
dashboard-capacite-tryptique 4/4 (testids absents de src/).
Les deux « READY TO VERIFY » ne le sont donc PAS : elles échouent sur des
montants, pas sur des libellés. Et le `getByText(/^Factures /i)` que la
raison de dashboard-data-flow lui attribue n'est pas dans ce fichier — il
est dans dashboard-cockpit-bloc2.spec.ts.
